findings.title: Quest KACE SMA CVE-2025-32975 (CVSS 10.0) Authentication Bypass Actively Exploited Via MSP→60-Org Pivot — 12k+ Internet-Facing Unpatched After 10-Month Vendor-Patch Window
findings.affected_technology: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance / K1000 on-prem endpoint-management platform
findings.summary: Quest KACE SMA SSO handler accepts attacker-supplied identity without credentials, yielding unauthenticated admin impersonation; Hunt.io confirmed ITW exploitation via a Boston MSP pivoting into 60+ downstream organizations.
findings.first_seen_at: securityaffairs.com — Quest KACE SMA flaw CVE-2025-32975

findings.title: OPNsense Core CVE-2026-44193 — XMLRPC restore_config_section Unauthenticated RCE On Widely-Deployed Open-Source Firewall (CVSS 9.1)
findings.affected_technology: OPNsense (open-source FreeBSD-based firewall platform) prior to 26.1.7
findings.summary: OPNsense XMLRPC method opnsense.restore_config_section fails to sanitize user-supplied input, allowing an unauthenticated attacker reaching the management plane to inject configuration that executes as the privileged firewall daemon, yielding RCE on the firewall itself.

findings.title: Microsoft May 2026 Patch Tuesday Update — MDASH Agentic AI Disclosure + CVE-2026-33824 IKEv2 ikeext.dll Pre-Auth RCE (CVSS 9.8) Adds Perimeter-Class Bug Not Previously Enumerated
findings.affected_technology: Windows IKEv2/IPSec stack (ikeext.dll), Windows TCP/IP IPSec, Microsoft Outlook
findings.summary: Microsoft disclosed that its MDASH agentic AI system found 16 of the May Patch Tuesday CVEs including CVE-2026-33824 — a CVSS 9.8 pre-auth double-free RCE in the Windows IKEv2 IPSec stack reachable on any internet-facing Windows VPN endpoint or RRAS deployment.
findings.first_seen_at: thehackernews.com — Microsoft's MDASH AI System Finds 16 Windows Flaws

findings.title: F5 NGINX Open Source CVE-2026-42945 — ngx_http_rewrite_module Vulnerability (CVSS 8.1) On Core HTTP Module Of Most-Deployed Web Server
findings.affected_technology: F5 NGINX Open Source (and likely NGINX Plus, OpenResty, Tengine, Angie, Kong, NGINX Ingress Controller)
findings.summary: Vulnerability in NGINX's ngx_http_rewrite_module disclosed via oss-security with CVSS 8.1; technical details limited but the module is reachable on any production NGINX deployment that uses rewrite/if/return directives, with downstream impact on the entire NGINX-derivative ecosystem.

findings.title: FamousSparrow (UAT-9244, China-Aligned) Targets Azerbaijani Energy Firm Via ProxyNotShell Exchange Chain — Three Intrusion Waves Across 60+ Days Despite Remediation
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Exchange Server on-premises (ProxyNotShell chain); Deed RAT (Snappybee) + TernDoor backdoors
findings.summary: Bitdefender published TTPs for a FamousSparrow/UAT-9244 multi-wave ProxyNotShell Exchange intrusion (Dec 2025–Feb 2026) re-using the same vector across three waves — confirming unpatched on-prem Exchange as a primary 2026-Q2 PRC initial-access vector.
findings.first_seen_at: thehackernews.com — Azerbaijani Energy Firm Hit by Repeated Microsoft Exchange Exploitation

findings.title: GemStuffer Campaign — 150+ Malicious RubyGems Used As Data-Exfil Channel For Scraped UK Local Government Portal Data
findings.affected_technology: RubyGems ecosystem abused as data-exfil channel (no software vulnerability — abuse-of-feature against public package registry)
findings.summary: Socket identified the GemStuffer campaign using RubyGems as a data-exfiltration channel — UK local-government portal content is scraped and republished as valid .gem archives, setting a package-registry-as-exfil-store precedent for npm/PyPI/Hugging Face.

findings.title: SPIP CVE-2026-8429 + CVE-2026-8430 — Twin Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities In Widely-Deployed French-Origin CMS
findings.affected_technology: SPIP CMS < 4.4.14 (open-source PHP-based, French public-sector default CMS)
findings.summary: SPIP shipped two distinct RCE primitives: CVE-2026-8429 (RCE via Private Space — reachable from low-privilege editor accounts) and CVE-2026-8430 (RCE chain via default nginx reverse-proxy misconfiguration exposing internal SPIP endpoints); both fixed in 4.4.14.

findings.title: Langflow CVE-2026-3345 — Path Traversal Via File Upload API On Widely-Used Open-Source AI Workflow Builder
findings.affected_technology: Langflow < 1.9.0 (open-source visual workflow builder for LangChain-based AI apps)
findings.summary: Langflow file-upload API contains a path traversal allowing arbitrary file writes outside the upload directory; combined with Langflow's default-no-auth posture, chains to RCE on the Langflow host — fourth AI-infrastructure CVE in 30 days following Open WebUI / FastGPT / Ollama.

findings.title: Strapi CVE-2026-22599 — SQL Injection In Content Type Builder (Critical) On Top-3 Open-Source Headless CMS
findings.summary: Strapi Content Type Builder allows SQL injection through a crafted request, yielding database-level read/write on the Strapi instance — direct impact on any application using Strapi as its data layer.

findings.title: Foxconn Confirms North American Factory Compromise By Nitrogen Ransomware — 8TB / 11M Files Exfiltrated, Schematics For Intel / Apple / Google / Dell / Nvidia
findings.affected_technology: Foxconn (Hon Hai Precision Industry) North American manufacturing infrastructure
findings.summary: Foxconn confirmed on 2026-05-13 the cyberattack first listed on Nitrogen's leak site 2026-03-12 — 8TB / 11M files exfiltrated including confidential customer schematics; affected factories resuming normal production. Downstream-customer schematic-leak impact assessment warranted.
findings.first_seen_at: securityweek.com — Foxconn Confirms North American Factories Hit by Cyberattack

findings.title: OpenLoop Health Confirms January 2026 Data Breach — 716,000 Patients Affected (Telehealth Infrastructure Provider)
findings.affected_technology: OpenLoop Health (B2B telehealth infrastructure platform serving multiple consumer-facing telehealth brands)
findings.summary: OpenLoop Health confirmed a January 2026 intrusion affecting 716,000 individuals — B2B telehealth infrastructure with records spanning multiple downstream telehealth-service partners; continues the pattern of healthcare-adjacent SaaS infrastructure as high-value target.
findings.first_seen_at: securityaffairs.com — OpenLoop Health confirms January 2026 Data breach

TOCTOU race in sed -i --follow-symlinks (oss-security 2026-05-13); local-only and niche but the ubiquity of sed warrants distro-tracking note.

CopyFile policy symlink bypass (oss-security 2026-05-13); niche cloud-native isolation stack.
Remote code execution in Web::Passwd Perl module (oss-security 2026-05-13); niche Perl module, low deployment, but RCE class.
Authenticated privilege escalation + API credential exposure in TeamCity self-hosted CI (helpnetsecurity 2026-05-12); not currently exploited but TeamCity is a recurring credential-theft pivot point.
Authenticated remote code execution via session serialization (vulncheck 2026-05-12); auth-required but session-serialization class often escalates to unauth via secondary primitives.
SQL injection through crafted requests on widely-deployed open-source ERP (OpenCVE 2026-05-13, CVSS 8.8); track for downstream Frappe/Bench deployment patches.

Bazaar marketplace stored-XSS chain to Electron code execution (CVE-2026-45375) plus publish-mode reader ungated config-write via eight APIs (CVE-2026-45371); GHSA 2026-05-13. Marketplace-rendering vector mirrors supply-chain patterns.
Public prompt pull deserializes untrusted manifests without trust-boundary warnings (GHSA 2026-05-13); matches the Apache OpenNLP model-loading + Hugging Face pickle pattern.
Linux command injection via unsanitized NetworkManager connection profile names in networkInterfaces() (GHSA 2026-05-13).
Webhook SSRF (CVE-2026-44797) plus writable GitRepository.current_head field via REST API (CVE-2026-44798) in Nautobot network-automation DCIM platform (GHSA 2026-05-13).
Twig sandbox escape allows editor-role users to exfiltrate plugin secrets via Config::toArray() (GHSA 2026-05-13); in-scope CMS class.
Command injection in tool.Check enabling arbitrary code execution (GHSA 2026-05-13); self-hosted tool-installer, niche.

Additional adminbin file-read (CVSS 8.6), cpdavd path-traversal/privilege-escalation (CVSS 8.6), and sqloptimizer SQL injection (CVSS 8.1) published alongside the 44193 unauth-RCE umbrella; defenders patching to 26.1.7 fix all together.
Shift-out-of-bounds in switchtec driver when MW LUT configuration is zero (CVSS 7.1, OpenCVE 2026-05-13); niche hardware path, primarily DoS-class.
Newly-released open-source autonomous bug-discovery tool (helpnetsecurity 2026-05-13); defensive-pattern data point in AI-bug-finder column alongside MDASH / Daybreak / Project Glasswing.
High-severity issue in cryptographic key-management platform (CVSS 8.7, dbugs.ptsecurity 2026-05-13); niche vendor but key-management classification.
